visualCharacteristics.purpose: Collapsible FAQ rows with a plus icon in a narrow column
visualCharacteristics.layout: Narrow centred column of bordered rows stacked vertically
visualCharacteristics.description: Bordered collapsible question rows with an orange plus icon on the right that turns into a minus when open.

contentPattern.structure: one row per question, two cells: [question] [answer]
contentPattern.notes: Uses native details/summary, so items work without JavaScript state and are keyboard accessible. Rows with an empty question are dropped; a missing answer renders an empty body.

usage: Quick Answers section on the WKND Adventures homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use for any FAQ or short question/answer list.
